rationale: The agent successfully authenticated the user by matching their name and zip code with the system. The agent checked the price and battery life of the bluetooth speaker, and correctly communicated that the price was over $300. Although the user wished to cancel only the bluetooth speaker, the policy allowed only a full cancellation or modification to a different item, which the agent communicated appropriately. The user opted to keep the order and the agent confirmed the total order price accurately, fulfilling the user's request without failure.
